title: Part 1, The Novice
note: Draft lessons from the open Orange book branch. They are one book with the original manuscript, not a second book. Two later novice lessons are still unwritten.

corrections.summary: Repair novice chapters 4–6 proofs and labels.
Date RFC 8439 as June 2018 in N7.
Correct N7's quarter-round trace and diagnostics.

lessons.title: A word before we begin
lessons.description: How to study the book without already knowing how to program or how cryptography works.

lessons.title: Chapter 1: Before You Hide Anything
lessons.description: Messages, confidentiality, keys, and what a single successful example can establish.

lessons.title: Chapter 2: Two Marks, Many Possibilities
lessons.description: Place value, binary, bits, bytes, hexadecimal, and the difference between a value and its notation.

lessons.title: Chapter 3: A Rule You Can Undo
lessons.description: Boolean operations, masks, XOR, and what an exhaustive check can honestly say.

lessons.title: Worked answers: Chapters 1–3
lessons.description: Worked answers for the opening exercises on messages, notation, and reversible rules.

lessons.title: Chapter 4: A Place to Work
lessons.description: Files, the terminal, and how to record the source revision and compiler you actually used.

lessons.title: Chapter 5: Tell the Machine Exactly
lessons.description: A first Orange program, names and scope, diagnostics, and the gap between accepted source and intention.

lessons.title: Chapter 6: Words Have Edges
lessons.description: Fixed-width words, wrapping, shifts, rotations, and why grouping is part of the calculation.

lessons.title: Worked answers: Chapters 4–6
lessons.description: Worked answers for the exercises on the working environment, a first program, and word arithmetic.

lessons.title: N7: Name the Intermediate Step
lessons.description: Bindings, explicit conversions, arrays, and the ChaCha20 quarter round written one named step at a time.

lessons.title: Worked answers: N7
lessons.description: Worked answers for naming intermediate steps, conversions, and the quarter round.

lessons.title: N8: Read and Repair a Program
lessons.description: How to predict a diagnostic, then repair grouping, conversion, bounds, and one wrong test.

lessons.title: Worked answers: N8
lessons.description: Worked answers for reading diagnostics and making one repair at a time.

lessons.title: N9: Say What You Mean
lessons.description: Sets, functions, quantifiers, and the elementary proof patterns used later in the book.

lessons.title: Worked answers: N9
lessons.description: Worked answers for the exercises on sets, functions, quantifiers, and proof patterns.

lessons.title: N10: Count What You Do Not Know
lessons.description: Ratios, finite probability, and the difference between key length, distribution, and uncertainty.

lessons.title: Worked answers: N10
lessons.description: Worked answers for the exercises on counting, probability, and uncertainty.
